tool-profile-replacement.history.title: Configuration handoff history
tool-profile-replacement.choose_existing: Choose an existing connection to reuse
tool-profile-replacement.source_unchange: This selection is the original configuration. Open the original connection; it will not hand off to or pause itself.
tool-profile-replacement.choose_target: Choose a new configuration or node first.
tool-profile-replacement.create_target: A new configuration will be created paused
tool-profile-replacement.confirm.title: Review configuration handoff
tool-profile-replacement.confirm.intro: Review the original configuration and exact target, then decide whether to pause the original as part of this operation. Existing fixed plans and runs are not migrated.
tool-profile-replacement.confirm.pause_h: This is an explicit additional choice. Pausing does not prove external processes stopped; original plans, runs and historical evidence are retained.
tool-profile-replacement.confirm.boundar: New targets remain paused; reused targets retain their state. Enabling uses the original separate flow. Current permissions, versions and fresh inventory are checked again on submission.
tool-profile-replacement.receipt.title: Configuration handoff saved
tool-profile-replacement.snapshot_hint: These profiles and states were recorded at handoff time. They do not establish current dispatch eligibility. Read the current configuration before enabling or making other changes.
tool-profile-replacement.receipt.pause_a: The original configuration was paused at handoff.
tool-profile-replacement.receipt.pause_u: This handoff did not request pausing the original configuration.
tool-profile-replacement.history.scope: Only this project's relationships for the selected profile and direction are read. No project-wide total is provided.
tool-profile-replacement.history.view_re: Waiting for the current account, organization, project and profile.
tool-profile-replacement.history.paused: Waiting for the current operation before reading handoff records.
tool-profile-replacement.history.refresh: Rechecking handoff records. Opening profiles is temporarily unavailable.
tool-profile-replacement.history.ready: Handoff snapshots were read for this direction.
tool-profile-replacement.history.stale: These are previous snapshots; current access has not been rechecked. Profiles cannot be opened until a successful read.
tool-profile-replacement.history.denied: Current access to this scope is unavailable. Previous records were cleared. Read again to check access.
tool-profile-replacement.history.error: Current handoff records could not be read. Try again.
tool-profile-replacement.history.empty: No handoff records are visible in this direction for this read.
tool-profile-replacement.history.continu: More handoff records are available to load.
tool-profile-replacement.history.end: This read reached the end of the currently visible records in this direction.
tool-profile-replacement.invalid_request: The configuration handoff request could not be verified. Retain the draft and review it again.
tool-profile-replacement.invalid_receipt: The configuration handoff receipt does not match the original request. Reconcile the original operation.
tool-profile-replacement.invalid_history: Configuration handoff records do not match the current read scope. Read them again.
